breakfast.name: Spinach and pepper egg muffins
ingredients: Olive oil or cooking spray for the pan
steps: On Sunday, heat the oven to 350 F and grease a 12-cup muffin tin.
Divide the spinach, bell pepper, and feta among the cups.
Whisk eggs, almond milk, garlic powder, salt, and pepper and pour over the vegetables until each cup is about three-quarters full.
Bake 20 to 22 minutes until set in the center, then cool and refrigerate in a container.
To serve, microwave 2 muffins per person for 30 to 45 seconds and eat with fruit on the side.

lunch.name: Cherry-cocoa protein smoothie
ingredients: 2 handfuls baby spinach or 1 cup frozen spinach
Optional: 1/2 frozen banana, 1/2 tsp cinnamon, or swap half the cherries for frozen mixed berries
steps: Add almond milk and yogurt to the blender first.
Add protein powder, spinach, cherries, almond butter, flaxseed, and cocoa.
Blend on high 45 to 60 seconds until smooth, adding a splash of water if too thick.
Pour into two glasses and drink right away.

dinner.name: Ginger-garlic shrimp stir-fry with snap peas and bell pepper
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined (thawed if frozen)
2 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce or coconut aminos
steps: Cook the riced cauliflower according to the package and keep warm.
Pat the shrimp dry, heat olive oil in a large skillet over high heat, and cook the shrimp 1 to 2 minutes per side until pink, then move to a plate.
Add snap peas and bell pepper to the pan and stir-fry 3 to 4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Add garlic and ginger and cook 30 seconds.
Return the shrimp with soy sauce, sesame oil, and honey, toss 1 minute, top with scallions, and serve over the cauliflower rice.

breakfast.name: Apple-cinnamon protein overnight oats
steps: The night before, stir oats, almond milk, Greek yogurt, protein powder, chia seeds, and cinnamon together in two jars.
Stir in half the diced apple, cover, and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, top each jar with the rest of the apple and the walnuts and eat cold.

dinner.name: Greek chicken meatballs with cucumber-tomato salad and tzatziki
steps: Heat the oven to 400 F and line a sheet pan with parchment.
Mix chicken, egg, feta, spinach, garlic, oregano, onion powder, salt, and pepper and roll into 12 to 14 meatballs.
Bake 16 to 18 minutes until the meatballs reach 165 F inside.
Meanwhile, grate a quarter of the cucumber, squeeze it dry, and stir it into the yogurt with lemon juice, dill, and a pinch of salt for the tzatziki.
Dice the rest of the cucumber, toss with tomatoes, red onion, olive oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper, and serve with the meatballs and tzatziki.

dinner.name: Beef and butternut squash chili
ingredients: 2 cups pre-cubed butternut squash, cut in 1/2-inch pieces
To top: 1/4 cup plain Greek yogurt, 1 avocado (diced), 1 scallion (sliced)
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and cook onion, bell pepper, and squash 5 minutes.
Add beef and garlic and cook 5 to 6 minutes, breaking up the meat, until browned.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, and smoked paprika and cook 30 seconds.
Add tomatoes, black beans, and broth, bring to a simmer, cover, and cook 15 minutes until the squash is tender.
Season with salt and pepper, serve half topped with yogurt, avocado, and scallion, and refrigerate the other half for Saturday lunch.

dinner.name: Sheet-pan pesto chicken with zucchini and cherry tomatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and line a large sheet pan.
Slice each chicken breast in half horizontally to make 4 thin cutlets and season with salt and pepper.
Toss zucchini and tomatoes with olive oil, salt, and pepper on the pan.
Nestle the chicken among the vegetables and spread the pesto over the chicken.
Roast 15 to 18 minutes until the chicken reaches 165 F, then squeeze lemon over everything and serve.

dinner.name: Maple-Dijon salmon with roasted green beans
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F and line a sheet pan.
Toss green beans with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper and roast 8 minutes.
Whisk Dijon, maple syrup, garlic, and the remaining oil together.
Push the beans to the sides, add the salmon, brush it with the glaze, scatter almonds over the beans, and roast 10 to 12 minutes until the salmon flakes easily.
Squeeze lemon over the salmon and beans and serve.

breakfast.name: Cottage cheese oat pancakes with berries
ingredients: 1 tsp olive oil or cooking spray
steps: Blend oats, cottage cheese, eggs, baking powder, cinnamon, and vanilla until smooth, then let the batter rest 5 minutes.
Heat a lightly oiled nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Pour about 1/4 cup batter per pancake and cook 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles form, then flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
Serve topped with berries and a spoonful of Greek yogurt.

lunch.name: Leftover beef and butternut squash chili
steps: Reheat the chili in a small pot over medium heat for 5 to 8 minutes, stirring, or microwave until steaming.
Divide between two bowls and top with Greek yogurt, avocado, and scallion.

dinner.name: Sheet-pan pork tenderloin with apples and sweet potato
ingredients: 1 medium sweet potato, cut in 3/4-inch cubes
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F, toss sweet potato and red onion with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper on a sheet pan, and roast 10 minutes.
Rub the pork with the remaining oil, Dijon, thyme, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Toss the apple wedges with cinnamon and add them and the pork to the pan.
Roast 18 to 22 minutes until the pork reaches 145 F, then rest it 5 minutes and slice.
Serve the pork, apples, and sweet potato over the spinach so the warm pan juices wilt it.

breakfast.name: Spinach and mushroom omelets
steps: Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat and cook the mushrooms 4 minutes until browned.
Add the spinach, cook 1 minute until wilted, and move the vegetables to a plate.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper, add the remaining oil to the pan, and pour in half the eggs.
Cook about 2 minutes until nearly set, add half the vegetables and feta to one side, and fold it over.
Repeat with the rest of the eggs and filling and serve with clementines.

lunch.name: Turkey and hummus lettuce wraps
steps: Spread a spoonful of hummus on each lettuce leaf.
Layer turkey, cucumber, and bell pepper on top and roll up.
Serve with cherry tomatoes on the side.

dinner.name: Lemon-caper baked cod with roasted cauliflower
steps: Heat the oven to 425 F.
Toss cauliflower with 1 1/2 tbsp olive oil, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper on a sheet pan and roast 15 minutes.
Push the cauliflower to the sides, add the cod, and drizzle it with the remaining oil, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Top the fish with capers and lemon slices and roast 10 to 12 minutes until it flakes easily.
Serve the cod with the cauliflower and spoon any pan juices over the top.
